answer.says: You are right, Sunil. I erred in the abstraction. The milk is the medium, the fuel, and the samosa the body. I accept the correction.
answer.thought: Sunil’s correction is sharp and practical; I am tired, and the heat has made me prone to unnecessary distinctions. I accept the samosa as the body demands, not as a philosophical proposition.
